message: Last week, we had a little power outage and my friend Lisa called in a flap, convinced we were about to be plunged into a survival reality show. I couldn’t help but chuckle as I reassured her that I had my trusty flashlight and a fully charged power bank on hand. We ended up enjoying a cozy evening playing board games by lantern light, and I realized that a little preparedness can turn a potential panic into a fun adventure. Do you have any go-to items for when the lights go out?
